meta.about: A word where a CSS declaration goes. The refusal spells out the shape, names `display: none` for the hide case, and the retry lands it.
meta.recorded-outcome: asked to hide the last bullet — after style_node's description was widened so the model stopped reaching for edit_text — Gemma emitted style_node({"target": "the bullets", "style": "remove"}). Right tool, right target, and a word instead of a declaration. The refusal explained the shape and then ended the turn, because `setStyles` set no `retry` and `style_node` would have dropped it anyway.
meta.guards: two replies for one ask, and it needs BOTH halves: `retry: true` on `setStyles`'s unreadable-style refusal, and `style_node` passing it through instead of rebuilding the result with `{ applied: false }`. Revert either and this consumes one reply.
